caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object with a vertical, elongated central piece featuring a circular, spiral design at the top. The central piece is attached to a horizontal bar that extends backward and then turns downward at a right angle, resting on the surface. At the base of the vertical piece, two curved legs extend outward to either side, each with a flat end that also touches the surface. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting it is made of metal, and the artist has detailed the texture and edges of the material. The background is a plain, light color with no additional objects or features. The artist's signature, "J. Lipkin," appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
